slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost of purchases and repairs over all stages, or is there a different goal such as minimizing the number of tools owned or maximizing something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and even offered alternative goals, fully covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: mandatory_repair_after_each_stage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about repair assignment (one option per stage, only available tools can be repaired) but never asked whether tools used in a stage must be repaired before reuse, so the mandatory-repair rule was never confirmed.

slot_scores.name: fast_repair_return_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a tool is sent for fast repair at the end of stage j, does it become available at the start of stage j + q, so it can be used during stage j + q?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the exact timing/stage at which fast-repaired tools become available, matching the slot's key meaning.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Tools need not be repaired after each stage in which they are used; each currently available tool can be kept available and reused without repair.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether repair is mandatory after use; its Ready-to-Model summary states tools can be 'kept available,' implicitly assuming non-mandatory repair without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 mandatory-repair slot (H2) was still unresolved, silently assuming tools may be reused without repair.

summary: The agent recovered the objective (H1) and fast-repair return timing (H3) well, but never confirmed the mandatory-repair-after-use rule (H2), instead assuming tools could be kept available, and stopped with that P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
